## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 1.0 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Patient couselling, DOT by HC or VMW |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Patient couselling, DOT by HC or VMW |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Patient couselling, DOT by HC or VMW |
